annotations.title: Create, schedule or publish a post

description: Create a new social media post. Saves as draft or schedules it for a specific time. X (Twitter): nothing sent to X may contain a link (URL, bare domain or t.co) — not the post, any thread segment, or a first comment (posted to X as a reply). The X API bills each link post at $0.20 vs $0.015, so the API rejects them; put a link-free version in platformContent.twitter.

campaign.description: Campaign tag, e.g. 'garmin-cirqa-2026' (slugified automatically). Sets utm.campaign and derives a utm.content token from the format (e.g. 'ig-carousel', 'fb-static'). Group/filter/bulk-delete by this with list_campaigns, list_posts({campaign}) and delete_posts({campaign}).

connectionIds.description: Array of social connection IDs to post to. Use list_connections or list_account_groups to find IDs.

label.description: Internal working name shown in the PlanPost dashboard list, e.g. 'Garmin CIRQA - IG Carousel'. Never published to any platform — it just makes a campaign's drafts tellable apart. Highly recommended when creating several posts at once.

media.description: Media attachments shared across every platform (use upload_media first to get URLs). Override per-platform via platformMedia.

platformContent.description: Per-platform content overrides, e.g. { twitter: 'shorter version', linkedin: 'longer version' }

platformMedia.description: Per-platform media overrides, e.g. { instagram: [<image>], twitter: [] } — instagram gets the image, twitter publishes with no media. Absent keys fall back to the shared `media` array. Empty `[]` is a meaningful 'no media on this platform'.

platformSettings.description: Per-platform settings, e.g. { instagram: { isReel: true }, youtube: { title: '...', visibility: 'public' } }. TikTok: a scheduled or published post MUST carry { tiktok: { privacyLevel } } with one of PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE, MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS, FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR, SELF_ONLY (TikTok makes the user choose who can view each video; without it the API returns 400). Optional tiktok flags: disableComment, disableDuet, disableStitch (default true = off), brandedContent, yourBrand.

postType.description: Explicit post type (clearer than platformSettings flags, and takes precedence over them). 'reel' needs Instagram/Facebook; 'short' needs YouTube/Instagram/TikTok/Facebook; 'story' needs Instagram/Facebook; 'thread' is X/Twitter-only and requires threadSegments. Defaults to 'post', or is inferred from platformSettings flags (e.g. { instagram: { isReel: true } } → reel). NOTE: a carousel is NOT a postType — attach media with type 'carousel' or use generate_carousel/render_carousel.

schedule.description: Natural-language schedule, easier and safer than hand-building ISO: 'now', 'draft', 'today 20:30 Europe/Warsaw', 'tomorrow 07:00', 'in 2 hours', 'next week'. Takes precedence over scheduledFor. A timezone may be appended to wall-clock forms; otherwise `timezone` (or UTC) applies.

scheduledFor.description: ISO 8601 datetime to schedule the post (e.g. '2026-04-10T14:00:00Z'). Omit for draft. Prefer `schedule` for anything other than an exact instant.

threadSegments.description: Ordered tweet segments for a thread (only used when postType='thread', X/Twitter-only). 2–25 segments, each 1–280 characters.

utm.description: Per-post UTM tag overrides applied when attribution mode is utm. Each field can include the `{platform}` placeholder (substituted per platform at publish time). Letters, digits, `-`, `_`, `.` only. Any field omitted falls back to the user's UTM defaults configured in Settings, then to a hardcoded fallback. Example: { campaign: "summer-2026", content: "weekly-tips" }.

name: create_post
